goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_soul_bolt: Replaces an Ars projectile with Goety's Soul Bolt. Native impacts are followed by the remaining spell effects. Amplify adds one potency; Dampen removes one. Consumes soul energy per launch, or per impact for repeating carriers.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ice_chunk: Summons Goety's native ice chunk above the selected entity or location. It gathers frost, tracks its target and falls with its native impact effects. Amplify increases potency.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_frost_nov: Creates a freezing shockwave at the selected entity or location, using Goety's damage and alliance rules. Amplify increases potency, AOE expands its radius and Extend Time increases freezing duration.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_entanglin: Raises Goety's entangling vines at the selected enemy or location. Extend Time increases their lifetime; AOE selects nearby enemies. Wild staffs retain their group-targeting bonus.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_soul_heal: Heals the selected ally or yourself with Goety's soul healing. Amplify increases potency; AOE also heals nearby allies. An invalid target or a fully healed group consumes no native resource.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_haunted_s: Summons native haunted skulls near the selected entity or location, retaining Goety pursuit, explosions, ownership and lifetime. Amplify boosts the summon, AOE increases explosion radius and Extend Time increases lifetime. Sneak-casting recalls existing skulls; no eligible skull means no charge.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_magic_bol: Replaces an Ars projectile with Goety's native Magic Bolt, including its curse and lingering magic ground on entity or block impact. Remaining Ars effects resolve after the native impact. Amplify increases potency; Extend Time increases curse and ground duration.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_iron_hide: Grants native Iron Hide to yourself or the selected ally. Amplify increases potency; Extend Time adds one native duration unit (one minute). Invalid targets consume no resource.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_chill_hid: Grants Goety's native Chill Hide to yourself or the selected ally. Frost staffs also protect nearby allies. Amplify increases potency; Extend Time adds one native duration unit (45 seconds).
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_weakening: Creates Goety's weakening wave around the selected entity or location. Enemies receive both Weakness and Sapped; allies are excluded using the original caster's allegiance. Amplify, AOE and Extend Time increase potency, radius and duration.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lightning: Calls Goety's native lightning onto the selected entity or block. Nearby lightning rods redirect it unless a Storm staff is used. Amplify increases damage. Native lightning visuals and interactions are retained.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_updraft: Creates Goety's native updraft blast at the selected entity or above the selected block, including damage, lift and particles. Wind staffs retain their area bonus. Amplify increases damage; AOE increases its area.
goety_nouveau.cast.unavailable: The Goety spell could not be cast. Check your soul-energy container and spell conditions.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fireball: Replace an Ars projectile with a native Goety fireball. Retains ignition, staff salvos and equipment-dependent Hell Bolt variants. Amplify increases potency; Burning increases the native burning parameter. Native impacts continue the remaining Ars effects.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_poison_da: Replace an Ars projectile with a native Goety poison quill. Ordinary shots retain gravity, underwater behavior, Wild staff piercing and robe-dependent venom. Amplify increases potency and Extend Time increases venom duration.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_shockwave: Release a native Goety shockwave at the selected entity or position, preserving area damage, particles and sound. Amplify increases damage and AOE increases radius.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cushion: Create a native Goety cushion at the selected entity or above a selected block. AOE increases radius and Extend Time increases its native lifespan.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_burning: Increase native burning intensity. Its effect depends on the spell; additional resources are paid on activation.
goety_nouveau.validation.burning: This spell does not support Burning.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fangs: Summon native Goety fangs from the selected point, using the incoming projectile direction or your facing. Sneaking creates native rings there; an Ominous staff adds side rows or outer rings. Amplify increases damage, Extension adds a fang to each row, and Burning, Life Absorb and Soul Eater modify native fangs.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ignite: Ignite the selected living target using Goety's native burning duration, or light blocks through the original fire-charge interactions. Burning adds one second per copy to entity ignition. Invalid targets and unchanged fire states consume no resource.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_extension: Adds one native range unit to a supported Goety spell. Currently adds one fang and 1.25 blocks to each straight Fangs row. It does not increase Ars targeting range or change the sneaking rings.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_life_abso: Fangs or Feast restore their player owner's health through native hits. At most one per phrase, incompatible with Amplify. Extra resources are paid on activation.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_soul_eate: Add one native Soul Eater level to Goety Fangs, up to ten. Eligible successful hits return native soul energy according to Goety's configuration; this is not mana regeneration or a guaranteed gain against every target. Additional cost uses the selected trigger resource.
goety_nouveau.validation.native_paramete: This spell does not support the selected Goety-specific augment.
goety_nouveau.validation.augment_limit: At most one Life Absorb and ten Soul Eater augments per spell phrase.
goety_nouveau.validation.absorb_potency: Life Absorb cannot be combined with Amplify.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wither_sk: Replace a projectile with a native Wither Skull, retaining Wither, explosions and healing on kills. Amplify increases potency; AOE expands explosions. Sneaking creates blue skulls; Nether staff adds a native salvo.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_feast: Attack enemies in the selected area with native fangs. AOE expands the search and Amplify increases potency. Ominous staff adds a ring of fangs around each enemy.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bulwark: Protect yourself or the selected ally with Goety's native shields. Amplify increases their number; Extend Time increases their lifetime. Existing shields cannot be refilled.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_discharge: Release an electrical burst at the selected entity or location, with native arcs and area damage. Amplify increases damage; AOE expands its radius. Storm staffs retain native chain lightning.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ice_spike: Fire a native ice spike that freezes its victim. Frost staffs turn it into a faster, piercing ice spear.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_lavaball: Fire a native lava bomb with its explosion, fire and equipment variants. Sneak to suppress terrain destruction; Nether staffs fire a salvo.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_steam: Replace a projectile with a native steam missile, including its flight, impact and knockback.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bouncy_bu: Fire a native bubble that bounces and bursts after repeated impacts. Abyss staffs fire a salvo. Special Ars carriers retain their own trajectory.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_electro_o: Fire a native electrical orb, tracking an enemy along the Ars launch direction. Storm staffs retain its area burst.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_surging: Fire a native homing orb with its electrical trails, Spasms and staff-dependent chaining.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_smack_sto: Fire a native stone that deals extra damage to airborne targets and forces them downward. Geomancy staffs fire a salvo.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blossom: Fire a native blossom ball that leaves poisonous thorns at its impact. Wild equipment retains its bonuses.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_magma: Fire a native magma bomb that explodes and summons loyal magma cubes. Nether staffs retain the additional eruption.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_bomb: Throw a native void bomb, retaining its growth animation, magical fire and secondary void shocks. Void staffs fire a salvo.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sword: Fire a native copy of a sword held in either hand, retaining its enchantments and native damage. A successful launch consumes ten durability.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_razor_win: Fire a native growing wind slash that cuts through enemies. Void staffs produce its native void variant.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_earth_fis: Raise a native earth fist at the selected point, with its delayed strike and lift. Geomancy staffs also strike nearby enemies.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ghost_fir: Raise native ghost-fire flowers at the selected point. Necromancy staffs retain their cluster variants; Extend Time increases their lifetime.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_leeching: Drain the selected living enemy using native leech damage and healing. Necromancy staffs also weaken the victim.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_launch: Launch yourself or a selected ally in the recipient's facing direction. Wind staffs strengthen the launch.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_eruption: Raises a native volcano at the selected point. Geomancy staffs raise three; its rocks, eruption and expiry remain native.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bio_mine: Places native mines around the selected point. They arm before exploding and leave acid pools; Abyss staffs double the batch.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_teeth: Summons a hovering tooth above the selected point. It falls and raises native spikes; Ominous staffs add salvos or sneaking rings.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_thunderbo: Strike the selected enemy or point with a native lightning beam. Storm staffs retain chain lightning and bypass nearby lightning rods.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_hail: Creates a native hail cloud above the selected point. It freezes enemies below; Frost staffs let the cloud follow its target.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_monsoon: Creates a native storm cloud above the selected point, retaining rain and lightning. Storm staffs increase its area and allow chain lightning.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fire_blas: A fiery blast at the trigger point damages, knocks back and ignites nearby enemies.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sonic_boo: Sends a sonic boom toward the selected target, bypassing armor and knocking it back.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flame_str: Summons native fire pillars at the trigger point, surrounding a selected entity.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_rift: Opens a native void rift at the trigger point, pulling nearby enemies and harming those at its center.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wind_blas: Blow a native gust from the selected point. Staff effects and wind-powered devices remain supported.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_overgrowt: Raise native vines around the selected enemy or point. Sneak-casting creates poison-quill vine turrets.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_glow_ligh: Replace an Ars projectile with native Glow Light. Impacts illuminate creatures or place a native light block.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_zombie: Summon native zombie servants near the selected point, sharing Goety limits and retaining staff variants. Sneak-casting recalls them.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_skeleton: Summon native skeleton servants near the selected point, sharing Goety limits and retaining staff variants. Sneak-casting recalls them.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_vex: Summon native allied vexes near the selected point. Sneak-casting dismisses your vexes, following native behavior.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sensing: Grant native Tremor Sense to yourself or a selected ally.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_rotation: Rotate the selected block using native rotation rules.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_trembling: Push enemies away from the selected point and slow their movement and digging.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_charge: Apply native electrical charge to a selected creature. Repeated charges retain their native effects.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_spikes: Raise native royal spikes from the selected point. Sneak-casting creates rings.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_leaping: Summon native Leapleaf servants near the selected point. Sneak-casting recalls them.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_barricade: Raise native barriers at the selected point. Sneak to summon explosive totems.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_hunting: Summon native hunting beasts near the selected point, retaining environmental and staff variants. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_mauling: Summon native mauling beasts near the selected point, retaining environmental and staff variants. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_reaper: Summon native reapers near the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_wraith: Summon native wraiths near the selected point, retaining environmental and staff variants. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_phantom: Summon native phantoms above the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_slimy: Summon native slimy servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_carrion: Summon native carrion servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_whisper: Summon native whispering servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_frostborn: Summon native frostborn servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_sprite: Summon native sprite servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_vanguard: Summon native vanguard servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blackguar: Summon native blackguard servants near the selected point, retaining their staff rules and lifecycle. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_killing: Curse the selected enemy at a cost to your own health.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bolting: Dash toward the selected target or point, shocking nearby enemies. Self casts follow your facing.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_illusion: Create your doubles near the selected point. Sneak-casting dismisses established doubles.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blazing: Summon native blaze servants at the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ghastly: Summon native ghasts at the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_guardian: Summon native guardian servants at the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_watching: Summon native watchlings at the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_snaring: Summon native snarelings at the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blasting: Summon native blastlings at the selected point. Sneak to recall.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_fire_brea: Grants yourself or an ally a sustained breath, consuming resources while active.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_frost_bre: Grants yourself or an ally a sustained breath, consuming resources while active.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_swarm: Grants yourself or an ally a sustained breath, consuming resources while active.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ministrou: Summons native stone ministrosities near the selected location. Geomancy gear may change their form.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_hogging: Summons short-lived burning hoglins beside the selected location. They charge and explode.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_breeze: Summons native breeze servants near the selected location.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_arrow_rai: Choose yourself or an allied living creature to sustain a native arrow rain at its aim.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_blizzard: Choose yourself or an allied living creature to sustain a native blizzard at its aim.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_meteor_sh: Choose yourself or an allied living creature to sustain native meteor salvos at its aim.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_ice_storm: Replace an Ars projectile with a growing native ice storm.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_bombardme: Choose yourself or an ally to hover and sustain native fireball salvos.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_thunderst: Choose yourself or an ally to sustain a native lightning storm.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_trident_s: Raise native lightning tridents around the selected location.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_corrupted: Grant yourself or an ally a sustained beam of corruption.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_water_jet: Grant yourself or an ally a sustained jet of water.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_prisma_be: Grant yourself or an ally a charging prism beam that strikes when fully charged.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_void_shoc: Choose yourself or an ally to sustain native seeking void shocks.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_quaking: Choose yourself or an ally to send native tremors forward. Sneaking expands them in rings.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_warding: Sustain native soul-energy warding for yourself or an allied player.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_flying: Grant yourself or an ally sustained flight following their own facing.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_whirlwind: Surround yourself or an ally with lifting wind that pushes nearby creatures and arrows.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_shocking: Let yourself or an ally sustain electrical attacks along their aim.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_telekines: Let yourself or an ally grasp a target and move it with their gaze.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_burrowing: Let yourself or an allied player steadily excavate along their gaze.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_cyclone: Release a moving cyclone at the selected point.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_tidal: Unleash a surging wave from the selected point.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_water_whi: Yourself or an ally strikes with a native water tentacle.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_illuminat: Yourself or an ally periodically places native lights in nearby dark space.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_pulverize: Process the selected block using native Goety pulverizing recipes.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_scatter: Deploy native mines around the selected point. A Geomancy staff sustains deployment around yourself or an ally.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_tunnel: Temporarily open a native tunnel through the selected block.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_grapple: Yourself or an allied player launches a native vine hook. Trigger again to retract.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_end_walk: Hide yourself or an allied player in shadow; return to the starting point when the effect ends.
goety_nouveau.glyph_desc.glyph_soul_ligh: Replace the projectile with a soul light that illuminates surfaces and marks creatures.
